rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## Space Marines 3.3.7

• Victrix Guard added; Victrix Honour Guard reworked.
• Melta Eradicators and Heavy Bolter Eradicators: 120 → 110 Points.

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

## Catalogue Bugfixes (September 21st)

• Configuration: standardized setup, tracker, bookkeeping, and documentation ordering across the listbuilder.
• Presentation: unit and linked-unit chevrons have been replaced with ◆.
• Additional Models: Victrix Guard, Victrix Honour Guard, Sanguinary Guard, Vanguard Veterans, Sternguard Veterans, Bladeguard Veterans, Devastator Centurions, and Assault Centurions optional-model checkboxes no longer use a prefix marker.

## Catalogue Bugfixes (September 20th)

• Captain datasheets now resolve Chapter Captain into final-state Chapter-specific Leaders. Captain, Gravis Captain, Phobos Captain, Jump Pack Captain, and Terminator Captain each have separate Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, and Salamanders entries.
• Ultramarines Captains gain Battlefield Scholar; Blood Angels Captains gain Red Thirst; Space Wolves Captains gain Deeds of the Vlka Fenryka; Salamanders Captains gain Forgemaster.
• Compiled Captains preserve the original points, Leader Point costs, loadouts, attachment compatibility, and other intrinsic Unit Abilities.

## Catalogue Bugfixes (September 19th)

• Practice games are now supported at 420 Points, including Chapter-aware Extra Unit Copy Cost rules.
• Optional Unit Abilities now only appear when their matching upgrade or loadout is selected, including Jump Packs, Sanguinary Banner, Covering Fire, Smoke Launchers, and other vehicle upgrades.
• Unit Ability profiles and list presentation have been updated across the army, including cleaner unit, loadout, attachment, and additional-model labels.
• The portable Space Marine vehicle roster has been synchronized with the current Manufactorum Imperium library, including conditional Unit Ability presentation.
• Existing Chapter, Leader Point, attachment, Rare, vehicle-bridge, and copy-cost behavior has been preserved.

## Catalogue Bugfixes (September 16th)

• Unit names: added source model-count suffixes to Victrix Guard (2 or 3), Victrix Honour Guard (2 or 3), Sanguinary Guard (2 or 3), Death Company Assault Intercessors (5), Jump Pack Assault Death Company (5), Death Company Intercessors (5), Blood Claws (5), Grey Hunters (5), Wolf Guard Terminators (2), Wolf Scouts (5), Thunderwolf Cavalry (3), Firedrake Terminators (2), Pyroclasts (5), Tactical Squad (5), Intercessors (5), Heavy Intercessors (5), Assault Intercessors (5), Terminators (2), Assault Terminators (2), Melta Eradicators (3), Heavy Bolter Eradicators (3), Eliminators (3), Reivers (5), Hellblasters (5), Devastators (5), Desolation Squad (5), Infernus Squad (5), Vanguard Veterans (2 or 3), Sternguard Veterans (2 or 3), Bladeguard Veterans (2 or 3), Suppressors (3), Inceptors (3), Aggressors (3), Scout Skirmishers (5), Scout Infiltrators (5), Infiltrators (5), Incursors (5), Devastator Centurions (1 or 2), and Assault Centurions (1 or 2).
• Vanguard Veterans: moved Storm Shield out of the ordinary sidearm selector and into a dedicated Storm Shield Vanguard Veteran polymorphic role while preserving the model's independent melee choice.
• Firedrake Terminators, Terminators, Assault Terminators, and Vanguard Veterans: replaced the temporary Coming Soon placeholders with complete player-facing loadout trees; Terminator heavy weapons and Vanguard Relic Blades use permissive-corrective cross-model validation.
• Contemptor Dreadnought: Dreadnought Power Fist packages may now be selected in both weapon slots, allowing a double Power Fist loadout.
• Leader Points: the 17 existing paid Leader roots cost 1 LP each; Sanguinary Priest remains uncharged.
• Catalogue maintenance: current implementation notes and historical comments consolidated for the live GS26 catalogue.
• Sanguinary Priest: Jump Pack now uses a checkbox-style Paid Wargear selection.
• Victrix Guard, Victrix Honour Guard, Sanguinary Guard, Sternguard Veterans, Bladeguard Veterans, Devastator Centurions, and Assault Centurions: optional additional models now use checkbox-style Additional Model selections.
• Sanguinary Guard: Sanguinary Banner now uses a checkbox-style Unit Upgrade selection.
• Converted standalone optional Cyclone Missile Launcher, Venerable, Advanced Jamming Beacon, Smoke Launchers, Whirlwind Storm Bolter, Armour Piercing High Explosive Shells, Hunter-Killer Missile, Dozer Blade, Combat Shield, Haywire Mine, Jump Packs, Storm Shield, and Trapmaster Melta Bomb options to checkbox-style selections.

CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS38
This catalogue now targets Game System revision 38. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE — SPACE MARINES 3.3.7 / GS37
Space Marines 3.3.7 targets Game System revision 37 and uses the current Chapter Configuration, Leader Points, Practice, Extra Unit Copy Costs, Unit Abilities, and presentation infrastructure. All 72 native datasheets retain their stable root IDs, points, Chapter gating, loadouts, attachment topology, Rare restrictions, paid wargear, and validation unless explicitly listed in the September 19th Catalogue Bugfixes section.

Seventeen paid Leader roots retain their existing intrinsic 1 LP costs. Sanguinary Priest remains uncharged exactly as in the live REV26 baseline. Captain, Gravis Captain, Phobos Captain, Jump Pack Captain, and Terminator Captain are the five  command roots; other paid Leaders remain unbadged.

Extra Unit Copy Costs uses one visible accounting entry while preserving distinct Troop and Other arithmetic and every existing Chapter-gated family condition. Six Troop families and forty-nine non-Rare Other families retain their live Quick / Standard / Long accounting. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 3 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other.

AUTHORING / PRESENTATION NOTES
Unit rows use ◆; the five Captain command roots use ; 🧰 marks Loadout Options; immediate model-role headers use the Space Marines 🛡️ marker; visible Leader attachment associations use 🔗; and Infantry, Vehicle, Monster, and Rare category labels use the current Game System icons. The eight paid optional extra-model selections use semantic ◆ Additional [Model] Model labels while preserving their existing checkbox mechanics. Top-level Unit Ability names are represented as shared Profiles for all 72 datasheets; nested sub-abilities are intentionally omitted.

SHARED LIBRARY BOUNDARY
Rhino, Land Raider, Predator, Astartes Basilisk, Whirlwind, Vindicator, Land Speeder, Dreadnought, Contemptor Dreadnought, and Leviathan Dreadnought are mirrored into Manufactorum Imperium Library V17 using their stable source root IDs. Manufactorum retains its existing Leviathan presentation-category ownership override; consumer catalogues continue to own local availability and Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic.

HISTORICAL CATALOGUE COMMENT
CURRENT STATE — SPACE MARINES 3.3.7 / GS26
The catalogue now has complete player-facing unit roots and loadout trees for the current Space Marines 3.3.7 source. The standard Updated / Patch Notes Configuration item is active.
Chapter is a required one-of-four Configuration: Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, or Salamanders. Chapter-specific roots use selected-safe hiding plus constructive wrong-Chapter validation while retaining their semantic Leader/Troop/Other categories.
All 17 counted Leaders cost 1 LP, use explicit attachment associations, and retain constructive missing-attachment validation. Eligible hosts enforce the one-attached-Leader limit. Assault Intercessors are the deliberate stateful exception: Jump Packs switch legal attachment state between normal and Jump Pack Leaders through permissive-corrective validation.
Additional Copy Costs are catalogue-local arithmetic over stable unit IDs: Troop families use 4 / 6 / 8 free copies by game size, Other families use 1 / 2 / 3, and each excess identical copy adds +20 Points.
Eliminators (3), Wolf Guard Terminators (2), and Thunderwolf Cavalry (3) use hidden semantic counters plus constructive errors for cross-model equipment caps rather than cross-hiding legal options.
The ten chapter-independent Space Marine vehicle roots are the source side of the Manufactorum Imperium mirror. Manufactorum Library V10 was audited against Space Marines REV18 before REV19; the portable executable trees are current. REV19 changes no portable vehicle executable payload, so no library sync is required.

AUTHORING / RUNTIME NOTES
The army PDF remains authoritative. Builder presentation models meaningful final-state decisions rather than reproducing every procedural replacement step.
Existing stable IDs are preserved. Optional one-item upgrades should use direct checkbox-style constraints on the selectable entry; optional Additional Model wrappers may remain when the max-one constraint lives on the model entry.
Source-derived rules text is not editorialized. Catalogue comments document implementation and runtime intent only.
The ten portable Space Marine vehicle root comments retain their existing source/mirror provenance wording in REV19 to avoid documentation-only divergence from Manufactorum V10.

HISTORICAL REVISION LOG
SPACE MARINES REV1 / GS18 — VEHICLE SCAFFOLD ONLY.
This catalogue is intentionally incomplete. It exists to establish the Space Marine Chapter selector, Chapter presentation semantics, Space Marines Vehicles presentation, stable vehicle unit IDs, source points/type/class metadata, and Additional Copy Costs infrastructure before any vehicle loadouts or rules are implemented. No Infantry, Leader, Troop, chapter-exclusive non-vehicle unit, weapon choice, paid wargear, unit rule, attachment rule, relic, psychic power, or other gameplay payload is implemented in this revision. The army rules PDF remains authoritative.

REV2 — MANUFACTORUM-READY VEHICLE SCAFFOLD
Aligned native vehicle presentation with the established Astra Militarum / Manufactorum bridge pattern. All eleven native Space Marine vehicle shells now present under Other while retaining their existing Space Marines Vehicles category links as non-primary compatibility tags. The ten chapter-independent vehicle shells are mirrored into Manufactorum Imperium V6 using the same unit IDs. Baal Predator remains local to Space Marines / Blood Angels and is not exported through Manufactorum.

REV3 — SPACE MARINES 3.3.6 / GS20 COMPLETE EMPTY UNIT SHELLS
Expanded the catalogue from the eleven-vehicle scaffold to all 71 unit roots in source skeleton order while preserving the existing catalogue ID, Chapter Configuration IDs, Additional Copy Costs Configuration IDs, and all eleven established vehicle IDs / Space Marines Vehicles bridge tags. Updated to Game System revision 20.
This phase intentionally implements only unit-level list-building structure: Points, Leader/Troop/Other, Infantry/Vehicle, counted unit-type semantics, Chapter gating, base Leader attachment relationships, host one-Leader capacity, and GS20 Troop/Other Additional Copy Costs. No internal loadouts, model cards, paid wargear, unit rules/profiles, or Additional Model controls are implemented.
ASSAULT INTERCESSORS ATTACHMENT NOTE: the source skeleton's Jump Packs option contains the only attachment_override in the army. The 3.3.6 PDF confirms the distinction explicitly: normal Captain/Librarian/Lieutenant attach to Assault Intercessors without Fly, while Jump Pack Captain/Librarian/Lieutenant/Chaplain attach to Assault Intercessors with Fly. Base Assault Intercessors therefore use the normal-Leader host state in REV3; the Jump Pack Leader host state will be added when the deferred Jump Packs loadout is implemented.

REV4 — CHAPTER-FIRST ARMY LIST PRESENTATION
Applied the established Chaos Space Marines Legion presentation pattern to Space Marine Chapters. All 15 chapter-exclusive units now use Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, or Salamanders as their primary Army List presentation category. Their source Leader/Troop/Other role remains as a secondary semantic category, together with Infantry/Vehicle, Leader Capacity, Additional Copy Cost, attachment, and other existing tags. No unit IDs, category-link IDs, points, Chapter gating, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, attachments, or other mechanics changed. Existing sort indices already place all chapter-specific units at 1-15 and generic Leaders from 16 onward, so the selected Chapter category appears above the standard Leader category.

REV5 — BLOOD ANGELS LOADOUT BATCH 1
Implemented player-facing loadouts for Sanguinary Guard (2 or 3), Sanguinary Priest, Death Company Assault Intercessors (5), Jump Pack Assault Death Company (5), Death Company Intercessors (5), and Baal Predator. Sanguinary Guard (2 or 3) uses separate model cards, one optional +50 Point third model, and Sanguinary Banner Paid Wargear. Sanguinary Priest has its fixed weapon package and +10 Point Jump Pack. The two assault Death Company units use the approved three-card compressed layout; Death Company Intercessors (5) use one veteran weapon card plus fixed models 2 and 3-5. Baal Predator keeps paid Sponson Weapons inside Loadout Options with (None) default; Dozer Blade remains Paid Wargear. No other unit roots, categories, Chapter presentation, attachments, Additional Copy Costs, points outside these loadouts, or existing stable IDs were changed.

REV6 — SPACE WOLVES LOADOUT BATCH
Implemented Wolf Guard Battle Leader, Blood Claws (5), Grey Hunters (5), Wolf Guard Terminators (2), and Wolf Scouts (5) using the approved compact final-state presentations. Wolf Guard Terminators (2) expose identical per-model final-state choices while constructive semantic validators preserve the source max-one special-melee and max-one Assault Cannon limits. Wolf Scouts (5) use named role cards, including a checklist-style Melta Bomb upgrade on Trapmaster. Thunderwolf Cavalry (3) remains intentionally unimplemented and now uses the same mandatory content-message pattern as Adepta Sororitas Sisters Novitiates, adapted to Space Marines. No other unit roots, Chapter presentation, attachments, Additional Copy Costs, points, or existing stable IDs were changed.

REV7 — THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY PERMISSIVE-CORRECTIVE LOADOUT
Replaced the Thunderwolf Cavalry (3) placeholder with three clean model cards and enforced its cross-model equipment caps through constructive semantic errors rather than cross-hiding. Storm Shields may be selected independently by all three models for +10 each. Melee Power Fist, Great Axe/Thunder Hammer, Plasma Pistol, and sidearm Power Fist each retain their source max-one unit limits. Also standardized the Wolf Guard Terminator special-melee error repair instruction to 'Choose a different loadout for one of those models.' No other unit mechanics, categories, Chapter presentation, attachments, points, or Additional Copy Costs were changed.

REV8 — RAPID-FIRE LOADOUT BATCH
Implemented the 44 approved simple Space Marine unit loadouts from Pyroclasts (5) through Astartes Basilisk. Presentation uses melee-first ordering where practical, explicit specialist/model cards where requested, atomic final-state packages, single-step Additional Model groups for the variable-size 2/3-model and 1/2-model units, and checklist-style direct Paid Wargear. Assault Intercessors now implement +20 Jump Packs with exact permissive-corrective attachment-state validation: normal Leaders are legal only without Jump Packs, while Jump Pack Captain/Librarian/Lieutenant/Chaplain are legal only with Jump Packs. The Sergeant melee dependency is also enforced constructively. Wolf Scouts (5) Pack Leader was renamed to include its unit name while preserving its existing ID. Existing unit IDs, Chapter-first presentation, Additional Copy Costs, points outside newly represented wargear/additional-model choices, prior Blood Angels/Space Wolves loadouts, and unrelated mechanics remain unchanged.

REV9 — GS21 CHAPTER CATEGORY ORDER
Retargeted to Game System revision 21. GS21 moves the four Chapter presentation categories above Leader in Army section ordering. No Space Marine unit IDs, loadouts, categories, points, attachments, Additional Copy Costs, or other catalogue mechanics changed.

REV10 — LOADOUT CORRECTION BATCH
Applied focused presentation and role corrections to Pyroclasts (5), Astartes Basilisk, Predator, Scout Infiltrators (5), Scout Skirmishers (5), Techmarine, Aggressors (3), Inceptors (3), Sternguard Veterans (2 or 3), Devastators (5), Reivers (5), and Melta Eradicators (3); implemented Hellblasters (5); removed Eliminators (3) from the playable catalogue. Eliminators (3) were also removed from Other Additional Copy Cost arithmetic and from the constructive Phobos Leader attachment text. Existing surviving IDs are preserved where the same player-facing decision survives.

REV11 — SPACE MARINES 3.3.7
Melta Eradicators (3) and Heavy Bolter Eradicators (3) changed from 120 to 110 Points. Added an automatically present under-construction notice instead of the normal Patch Notes template. Game System remains revision 21. No other catalogue mechanics changed.

REV12 — VICTRIX REWORK + FLY ATTACHMENT AUDIT
Added the new Victrix Guard (2 or 3) and fully implemented the reworked Victrix Honour Guard (2 or 3) from Space Marines 3.3.7. Both are 2-3 model Ultramarines Other units at 50 Points per model with an explicit +50 Additional Model. Victrix Guard (2 or 3) carries Bolt Carbine, Power Weapon & Ultima Storm Shield; Victrix Honour Guard (2 or 3) carries Bolt Carbine & Power Weapon. Both use the existing Captain/Librarian/Lieutenant/Chaplain host semantics. Added Victrix Guard (2 or 3) as a new independent Other Additional Copy Cost family. Audited Assault Intercessor Fly-dependent Leader attachments against the current PDF: preserved all eight normal-vs-Jump-Pack Leader state validators because the new Unit Skeleton omits those qualifiers, and removed the stale Wolf Guard Battle Leader Fly restriction because the current PDF does not state one. The catalogue remains Space Marines 3.3.7 on Game System revision 21 and retains the under-construction notice.

REV13 — TROOP LOADOUT BATCH + DEATH COMPANY / BAAL CLEANUP
Corrected Death Company Intercessor 1 to the 3.3.7 conditional Bolt Rifle replacement structure. Suppressed the redundant Baal Predator Sponson Weapons header. Implemented complete player-facing loadout trees for Tactical Squad (5), Intercessors, and Heavy Intercessors (5) using direct model-role presentation rather than procedural replacement wording. All source point costs are represented visibly: Tactical combi packages +10, Heavy Intercessor Hellstorm/Executor rifle upgrades +10 each, and Heavy Weapons Specialist Hellstorm/Executor Heavy Bolter upgrades +10. No root points, categories, attachments, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, Fly-state validation, Victrix work, or unrelated mechanics changed.

Implemented complete listbuilder loadouts for Whirlwind, Vindicator, Land Speeder, Dreadnought, Contemptor Dreadnought, and Leviathan Dreadnought from the Space Marines 3.3.7 source. Player-facing architecture intentionally follows established CSM vehicle conventions where equivalent: anonymous weapon pools instead of physical arm labels, atomic fist + auxiliary packages, Venerable as a Unit Upgrade, and independent repeated selectors for 'any two' / 'four of any' source wording. No root points, categories, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, attachment logic, Fly-state validation, Victrix work, Troop loadouts, or unrelated catalogue mechanics changed. The six stable vehicle roots are synchronized into Manufactorum Imperium Library V8 in the same pass.

REV15 — CATALOGUE CORRECTION BATCH
Added the Vindicator's fixed Siege Shield; corrected Astartes Basilisk Paid Wargear so Smoke Launchers and Armour Piercing High Explosive Shells may be selected together; replaced Predator and Land Raider literal '(None)' options with genuinely optional selectors; removed Boltgun from the Scout Infiltrator Heavy Weapons Specialist; and split Techmarine Omnissian Axe & Servo-Arm into separate fixed equipment lines. No root points, categories, attachment logic, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, Fly-state validation, chapter gating, or unrelated loadouts changed. The four affected shared vehicle roots are synchronized into Manufactorum Imperium Library V9.

REV16 — ELIMINATORS RESTORED / PERMISSIVE-CORRECTIVE LOADOUT
Restored Eliminators (3) using their original stable root ID 17c7-9184-1413-efff. All three models now expose the same five loadout choices, with +10 Point Bolt Carbine & Covering Fire and +10 Point Las Fusil. Four catalogue-local hidden semantic categories and constructive errors enforce the source one-model caps for Hyperfrag, Executioner, Mortis Bolts, and Bolt Carbine & Covering Fire. Restored Eliminators (3) as an eligible Phobos Captain / Librarian / Lieutenant attachment host and restored its six-modifier Other Additional Copy Cost family. No Game System change or unrelated mechanics changed.

REV17 — CHECKBOX + PLACEHOLDER CLEANUP
Flattened standalone optional one-item wrappers into direct checkbox-style selections for Cyclone Missile Launcher, Venerable, Advanced Jamming Beacon, Smoke Launchers, Whirlwind Storm Bolter, Armour Piercing High Explosive Shells, Hunter-Killer Missile, Dozer Blade, Combat Shield, Haywire Mine, Jump Packs, Storm Shield, and Wolf Scouts (5) Trapmaster Melta Bomb. Only genuinely independent binary options were flattened: Land Speeder missile choices, Land Raider pintle choices, Predator/Baal weapon packages, Thunderwolf Storm Shields, Wolf Guard Storm Shields, and other mutually exclusive loadout choices remain radio-style selectors. Baal Predator Dozer Blade was converted by moving its existing Paid Wargear max1 constraint directly onto the existing selection. Sanguinary Banner was moved from Paid Wargear to Unit Upgrade and given the same direct checkbox treatment. Added a concise Coming Soon rule to Firedrake Terminators (2), Terminators, Assault Terminators (2), and Vanguard Veterans (2 or 3) pointing players to the authoritative Space Marines PDF in the Reforged Discord. Root points, loadout legality, attachment rules, Eliminator permissive-corrective validation, Additional Copy Costs, GS21 target, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

REV18 — ADDITIONAL MODEL CHECKBOXES
Converted all seven optional Additional Model slots currently present in the Space Marines catalogue to direct checkbox-style selections by moving each existing group-level max-1 constraint onto its existing child entry. This affects Victrix Guard (2 or 3) 3, Victrix Honour Guard (2 or 3) 3, Sanguinary Guard (2 or 3) 3, Sternguard Veteran 3, Bladeguard Veteran 3, Devastator Centurion 2, and Assault Centurion 2. No groups or entries were moved, renamed, reordered, added, or removed. Existing entry types, stable IDs, names, hidden values, sortIndex values, points costs, nested loadouts, rules, modifiers, categories, and infoLinks are unchanged. Existing REV17 checkbox cleanup, concise Coming Soon placeholders, Additional Copy Costs, GS21 target, root points, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged. Catalogue Bugfixes remains cumulative and the new checkbox entry was appended.

REV19 — SANGUINARY PRIEST CHECKBOX + COMMENT CONSOLIDATION
Moved the Sanguinary Priest Jump Pack's existing max-one constraint from its one-item Paid Wargear wrapper onto the existing Jump Pack entry so it renders as a direct checkbox while preserving the same ID, +10 Point cost, and source rule text. Consolidated live catalogue documentation: current-state guidance now precedes the historical build log, obsolete EMPTY UNIT SHELL declarations were removed from implemented non-library units, the four genuinely unfinished units are explicitly marked current/incomplete, and Chapter / Additional Copy Costs comments now describe GS21 behavior. No points, Chapter gating, attachment topology, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, unit availability, source-derived rules text, or portable Manufactorum vehicle executable payload changed. Manufactorum Imperium Library V10 was audited against Space Marines REV18 and required no sync.

REV20 — LEADER POINTS MIGRATION
Retargeted the catalogue to Game System revision 24. Wolf Guard Battle Leader; Captain, Gravis Captain, Phobos Captain, Jump Pack Captain, Terminator Captain; Librarian, Phobos Librarian, Terminator Librarian, Jump Pack Librarian; Lieutenant, Phobos Lieutenant, Jump Pack Lieutenant; Chaplain, Terminator Chaplain, Jump Pack Chaplain; and Apothecary Biologis now each cost 1 LP, exactly matching the 17 existing Counts Toward Leader Maximum roots. The legacy count tags remain intact for parallel migration validation. Sanguinary Priest remains an Infantry non-Leader and receives no LP cost. Chapter selection/gating, Leader attachment topology, Assault Intercessor Fly-state validation, Coming Soon payloads, Additional Copy Costs, Eliminator/Wolf Guard Terminator/Thunderwolf semantic counters, points, loadouts, unit availability, and all ten portable Space Marine vehicle executable trees remain mechanically unchanged. No Manufactorum library sync is required for this Leader-only migration.

REV21 — LEADER POINTS CLEANUP
Runtime validation passed for ordinary paid Space Marine Leaders and the intentionally uncharged Sanguinary Priest. The 17 legacy Counts Toward Leader Maximum links matched the 17 1-LP Leader roots exactly and were removed. Sanguinary Priest remains without an LP cost object. Blood Angels units, Chapter gating, attachment rules, Additional Copy Costs, Manufactorum vehicle payloads, points, loadouts, shared vehicle content, and all unrelated Space Marines mechanics remain unchanged. REV21 retained the temporary under-construction Configuration item at that stage; this was retired in REV25 after the final four loadouts were implemented and runtime-approved.

REV22 — CONTEMPTOR DOUBLE POWER FIST BUGFIX
Removed the two mutual-hide modifiers that prevented both Contemptor weapon selectors from choosing Dreadnought Power Fist &. Both arms are now independent. No points, profiles, mandatory selector constraints, or stable IDs changed. Portable shared content was synchronized to Manufactorum Imperium V15.

REV23 — FINAL FOUR LOADOUT IMPLEMENTATION
Replaced the remaining Coming Soon payloads on Firedrake Terminators (2), Terminators, Assault Terminators (2), and Vanguard Veterans (2 or 3). Terminators use two flat model cards with independent ranged/melee selectors and a permissive-corrective one-heavy-weapon cap; Cyclone Missile Launcher is direct Paid Wargear. Firedrakes use polymorphic final-state roles: Dragonscale Shield Terminator, Lightning Claws Terminator, and +10 Point Combi-Bolter Terminator. Assault Terminators (2) use atomic Lightning Claws vs +10 Thunder Hammer & Storm Shield per model. Vanguard Veterans (2 or 3) use polymorphic ordinary / Relic Blade / Lightning Claw roles, a direct +40 third model, three independent +10 grenade/bomb upgrades, and a permissive-corrective max-one Relic Blade validator. No root points, categories, attachment topology, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, or existing root IDs changed.

REV24 — VANGUARD STORM SHIELD POLYMORPHIC ROLE
Refined Vanguard Veterans (2 or 3) so Storm Shield no longer appears in the ordinary sidearm selector beside pistols. Each model now exposes Vanguard Veteran, Storm Shield Vanguard Veteran, Relic Blade Vanguard Veteran, and Lightning Claw Vanguard Veteran as final-state roles. The Storm Shield role preserves an independent melee selector. The three existing Storm Shield selection IDs were reused as the new role IDs; new deterministic IDs were created only for the role-local cloned melee selectors and their child entries. Unit points, Relic Blade validation, third-model cost, Paid Wargear, categories, attachments, and Additional Copy Cost semantics are unchanged.

REV25 — STANDARD UPDATE ITEM / CONSTRUCTION STATUS RETIRED
The Space Marines catalogue no longer uses the temporary under-construction Configuration item. The existing Configuration entry f76e-9596-0509-9cb1 was renamed Updated: September 16th and its existing rule 4fae-07c4-a165-5a51 was converted to the standard Patch Notes presentation. The warning preamble was removed; current Space Marines 3.3.7 source notes and the cumulative Catalogue Bugfixes section remain visible. No unit, loadout, points, category, attachment, validation, Additional Copy Cost, or Leader Points mechanics changed.

REV26 — UNIT SIZE NAME PRESENTATION
Added source model-count suffixes to 39 squad-unit roots across Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, Salamanders, and generic Space Marines. Stable unit IDs, points, categories, Chapter gating, loadouts, attachment topology, Fly-state validation, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, Leader Points, Manufactorum vehicle content, and all other mechanics are unchanged. childName metadata, constructive error text, and catalogue comments were synchronized to the new visible root names.

REV27 — CURRENT TEMPLATE / PRACTICE / UNIT ABILITIES / MANUFACTORUM V17 SYNC
Consolidated the current-template update from the live REV26 baseline. Retargeted to Game System revision 37; renamed and flattened Extra Unit Copy Costs while preserving all existing Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic and Chapter conditions; added 420 Point Practice compatibility; adopted the current unit/loadout/model/category/attachment presentation; marked the five Captain roots as the selective  command tier; renamed eight paid optional extra-model selections semantically; added top-level Unit Ability profiles for all 72 datasheets; and synchronized the ten portable Space Marine vehicle roots into Manufactorum Imperium Library V17. The five generic Captain roots that carried the Chapter Captain placeholder are compiled into twenty final-state Chapter-specific Leader roots: Captain, Gravis Captain, Phobos Captain, Jump Pack Captain, and Terminator Captain for Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, and Salamanders. Ultramarines resolves Chapter Captain to Battlefield Scholar; Blood Angels to Red Thirst; Space Wolves to Deeds of the Vlka Fenryka; Salamanders to Forgemaster. The original Ultramarines variants retain the five historical root trees/IDs; the other fifteen variants use deterministic cloned IDs. Points, LP, loadouts, attachment categories/associations, optional wargear, and all non-Captain native roots are unchanged.

REV29 — DIAMOND UNIT MARKERS / ADDITIONAL MODEL CLEANUP
Starting from the compiled Chapter Captains REV28 branch, replaced remaining unit-row and linked-unit chevrons with ◆ throughout the catalogue and synchronized mirrored childName metadata. The eight optional Additional Model checkboxes for Victrix Guard, Victrix Honour Guard, Sanguinary Guard, Vanguard Veterans, Sternguard Veterans, Bladeguard Veterans, Devastator Centurions, and Assault Centurions now use plain unprefixed labels.
